message: v10.7.7 adds a full serving-economy and datacenter-capacity system. Model optimization is now limited to a small number of meaningful generations with sharply rising RP cost and substantial reductions in serving compute/cost. Language models now expose simulated run cost per 1M input/output tokens, daily token traffic and fleet-load share. Subscription usage/context/priority consume serving capacity, capacity limits commercial growth, retiring models frees load, and Compute Operations shows a live capacity graph. Rival cyber damage is now visible and persistent on the Rivals tab, repeated severe disruption can force a market exit, Custom AI Silicon is substantially stronger, and all four difficulties are rebalanced. Existing v10.7.6 research-flow changes, licensing and human-voice tutorial remain included.
